name: kimi-mem
description: Persistent memory for Kimi Code — compresses and recalls session context across sessions (kimi-mem for Kimi Code).

hooks.command: node scripts/bun-runner.js scripts/worker-service.cjs hook kimi context-once
node scripts/bun-runner.js scripts/worker-service.cjs hook kimi session-init
node scripts/bun-runner.js scripts/worker-service.cjs hook kimi observation
node scripts/bun-runner.js scripts/worker-service.cjs hook kimi file-context
node scripts/bun-runner.js scripts/worker-service.cjs hook kimi summarize
